sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Satin Scrunchie & Chocolate Hamper for Her
sourceNotes.rawContent:
A thoughtfully curated gift hamper packed with pretty accessories, indulgent treats, and a relaxing skincare treat — perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, Rakhi, or just because. Beautifully packed in a kraft gift box with dried flower fillers for that premium unboxing feel.
What's Inside:
- Satin Rose Hair Ties (Set of 2)
- Satin Bow Hair Clip – Ivory
- Satin Scrunchies (Set of 4 – Assorted Colours)
- Sunfeast Dark Fantasy Choco Fills
- Hershey's Kisses – Hazelnut 'n' Cookies
- Naliao Natural Collection Pomegranate Sheet Face Mask
Why She'll Love It:
- Handpicked mix of beauty, self-care & sweet treats
- Ready-to-gift packaging, no extra wrapping needed
- Ideal for birthdays, anniversaries, Rakhi, Karwa Chauth, or a surprise "just because" gift
Note: Cash on Delivery (COD) is not available for this hamper. Prepaid orders only.
